3129-3967-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3129-3967-5254.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

147-1893-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-5231.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

728-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
728-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat from step 4.

5231-6249-7920--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5231-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

765-1558-2638-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2638-4231-7824.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3240-5256-6462-7422.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

856-5776-6797-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1558-3478-3875-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3478-3875-4231-4772.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4613-4968-6843-7315.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and High Score.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1169-1563-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn and that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1169-1563-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

513-527-4742.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-3263-5953-7292.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-5953-7292.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-5953-7292.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4028-4222-6723.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

323-2034-4681-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1251-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3817-3991-5147.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1492-2866-4986-5226.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4986-5226.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

339-677-2292-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2523-5297-6798.description:
Activate Sarkhan's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing it to become a legendary 4/4 Dragon creature with flying, indestructible and haste.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sarkhan.
When Sarkhan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sarkhan that isn't legendary.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat using the Sarkhan token.

856-4659-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2239-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2239-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Ardent Elementalist and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Ardent Elementalist, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1350-5921-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

643-1429-2099-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-2099-5402.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

2034-3542-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
2034-3542-5003.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {C}{C}.
When Palinchron dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If the lands can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2713-4050-4893-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2713-4050-4893-5140.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Training Grounds and Zirda, putting the creature card onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

215-4872-5238.notablePrerequisites: Ethereal Forager does not have summoning sickness.
215-4872-5238.description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Time Warp from exile to your hand.
Activate Termur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

250-1525-2657-4688.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
The number of creatures you control plus the number of land cards in hand and library is equal to or greater than twenty.
250-1525-2657-4688.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Gitrog triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put the land into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat until you control twenty or more creatures.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

1908-2105.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
